plugin.name: Widescreen Fix
resx.description: Width of the screen in pixels. Desktop uses the desktop's resolution.
resy.description: Height of the screen in pixels. Desktop uses the desktop's resolution.
renderresx.description: Width of the 3D scene in pixels. Desktop renders at the screen's resolution.
renderresy.description: Height of the 3D scene in pixels. Desktop renders at the screen's resolution.
displaymode.description: Full screen, a borderless window or a window
cinematicbars.description: Black bars in cutscenes, as on the PS2
movies.description: Original aspect, fill the screen with correct proportions and cropping, or stretch to the screen. Applies during playback.
images.description: Framing of notes, pictures and the pause screen
intro.description: Logos and opening movie at startup
sh2reference.description: Keeps the Silent Hill 2 references of the PC release in new games
camera.description: Fixed angles or a free camera over the shoulder
cameraspeed.description: Turning speed of the free camera
invertcamera.description: Invert up and down for the free camera
fov.description: How much the free camera shows
dofres.description: Resolution of the blur and depth of field
statusres.description: Resolution of the picture behind the pause screens
anisotropy.description: Sharper textures seen at an angle
textlanguage.description: The language of the fix's options in the game's menu, and of the other plugins' pages there. Auto follows the game's language; choose one when a translation of the game replaced its language.
menu.title: Plugins
menu.restarthelp: Applies the next time the game starts
menu.presethelp: Vanilla: as released. Enhanced: everything turned up
menu.settingsfilehelp: Shows the settings file in File Explorer
sh2.fix2d.description: Corrects the menus, text and pictures for widescreen.
sh2.fmvwidescreen.description: Shows the movies wider, cropping the letterbox bars of the original.
sh2.cutsceneborders.description: Letterbox keeps the bars of the original cutscenes; Off removes them.
sh2.cutscenefov.description: Cutscenes use a narrower view (Vert-) so that characters meant to be off screen stay hidden.
sh2.noiseres.description: Resolution of the film grain effect. 1 to 4 pick the sizes of earlier versions.
sh2.lightingfix.description: Fixes a flashlight bug and restores the fog and lighting of one of the ending cutscenes.
sh2.fpslimit.description: The game's frame rate limit. Higher values may cause bugs.
sh2.ps2cameraspeed.description: Camera speed of the PS2 version. Meant for a 30 FPS limit.
sh2.gamepadfix.description: Allows the same button to be assigned to several actions.
sh2.singlecore.description: Compatibility option for audio looping on affected systems. Disabled by default; enabling it restricts the game to one CPU core.
sh2.safemode.description: Stops the game from resetting its settings after it was closed.
sh2.localfix.description: Creates the local.fix file that anti-aliasing needs.
sh2.steamcrashfix.description: Prevents a crash when Steam's controller configuration is used.
sh2.fullscreenimages.description: Crops the letterbox bars of pictures so they fill the screen.
sh3.api.description: Choose the Direct3D 9 renderer beneath d3d8to9. Vulkan is available after FusionFixHub installs DXVK. Restart the game after changing this setting.
sh3.aa.description: Smooth the main 3D scene at its native resolution before effects and interface text. TAA uses camera motion and depth; DLAA and FSR require Vulkan and the FusionFixHub runtimes. Temporal modes need d3d8to9 and sampleable scene depth.
sh3.sharpness.description: Sharpen the resolved scene. Zero keeps the AA result without extra sharpening; higher values emphasize fine edges.
cutsceneborders.description: Keep the original cinematic bars, limit cutscenes to a centered 4:3 image, or use both. Removing letterbox bars crops the image so their hidden areas remain hidden.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view. 1.0 keeps the intended framing; larger values widen the view. Cutscene framing is unchanged.
hudconstraint.description: Auto places the side-anchored HUD at the screen edge. A ratio places it at the edge of a centered box. Menus, pictures and centered text keep their intended framing.
ConfineCursor.description: Keep the cursor inside the active game client area. Releases on focus loss, window dragging, system menus or when disabled. Independent of mouse input.
menu.restoredefaultshelp: Sets the settings of this page to their defaults.
menu.restartwarning: The game must be restarted to apply some settings.
